# Crypto Execution Weekly

> Independent crypto news and analysis for active traders, focused on how trading systems are built and used.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://ethereumnews.github.io/): Latest coverage of execution, liquidity and protocol changes.
- [About](https://ethereumnews.github.io/about/): Editorial purpose, independence, sourcing and corrections policy.

## Coverage
Exchange engines, order routing, perpetuals, transaction ordering and settlement.
Reporting connects implementation choices to fills, fees and liquidity flows.
